caption:
Most owners know their ad budget to the dollar.

Few know how many hours a week they can actually pick up the phone.

Run the math: hours open ÷ 168. For a standard 50-hour week, that leaves 118 hours uncovered, and inbound calls don't wait for office hours to ring.

That gap is a coverage problem. It closes with automated follow-up that answers whether or not someone sits at a desk.

See it cover your hours for 14 days, no card needed.
